$description: Figma component ↔ Swift code mapping for the Coco design system. Code Connect needs a Figma Organization/Enterprise seat (the Coco-2 file is on a plan without it — checked 2026-10-27), so this file is the mapping; scripts/tokens/check_figma_map.py verifies every entry still points at real code. Entries are in the Coco-2 file (figmaFile) unless their figma.file is "legacy", which means the original Coco file (legacyFigmaFile) — the Theme look that Settings still uses. Node ids and keys come from the Figma files.

components.notes: Kind → kind (.primary/.secondary/.quiet), Size=Compact → compact: true. Hover/Pressed/Disabled are runtime states.
Size=Regular → height 28 (tabs, 26 in Focus); Size=Small → height: 22 (Settings).
State=Selected ↔ isSelected; Done ↔ task.isCompleted. Title and metadata live on the exposed Text / Task Title instance.
Reason and title live on the exposed Text / Label & Title instance (“text”).
Top row is the exposed Panel / Status Bar (“status”); Coco's line is the exposed Text / Prompt Line (“speech”).
Tail ↔ SpeechBubbleView.Tail (.bottom/.leading/.trailing).
Stand-in for the native control; not restyled in code.
Stand-in for the native control.
Title and detail live on the exposed Text / Title & Detail (Small) instance (“text”).
Vectors exported from the code (SnapshotRenderer.exportMascot); State ↔ CharacterState + idle events/reactions.
Rendered by SnapshotRenderer.renderIcon into Resources/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset.
Origin ↔ model.draftOrigin (.voice / .chat).
Prompt ↔ model.completionPrompt != nil.
Due=Date ↔ draft.deadline != nil; Due=Quick shows quickDue buttons.
State ↔ draft empty / ready, assistant.isResponding, voiceIn.isListening.
Exposed inside Task Row as “content”; holds the title and meta properties.
Size=Small is the Extra card's title and detail (exposed as “text”); Size=Large is a welcome step's heading and intro.
Exposed inside Up Next Card as “text”.
Exposed inside Chat / Coco Message as “activity”.

Kind ↔ where the dot is used: Step = OnboardingView step dots, Status = PanelRootView header + ConnectionsView, Activity = ChatView activities, Thinking = ThinkingDots (Off = 0.3 opacity), Listening = TodayView ListeningDot. Bars are Meter Segment.
State=Listening ↔ voice.isListening (accent stop key). Used inside Quick Add.
State=Disabled ↔ assistant.turns.isEmpty. Exposed inside Chat / Composer as “new chat”.

State ↔ start/end vs now: Upcoming, Next (RelativeTiming.untilStart), Soon (≤15 min, accent), Now (RelativeTiming.remaining, Join primary), Past (opacity 0.5, no Join). Show Source is off in the design; code shows a source label for non-Google events (open gap).
Open time from Availability.openings; 30+ min on the Today card.
Agenda.comingUp(after:limit: 3); day label from RelativeTiming.day.
Load=Busy ↔ booked ≥ 0.85 of working hours.
Expanded ↔ model.scheduleExpanded.
Included ↔ AppleCalendarService.isIncluded (AppleCalendarInfo.isIncludedByDefault until switched).
Reads model.agenda (merged Google + Apple + Partiful). State=Week ↔ WeekScheduleView. State=Loading ↔ agenda.events(on: today) == nil (“Loading today…”).
State ↔ AppleCalendarService.Access + isEnabled + isRequesting; Read Failed ↔ problem(for: .now).
